data.name: PageTitle
data.comment: Page title of the move house page.

data.name: Title
data.comment: Heading of the move house page, opened from Rooms and tags.

data.name: StepOf
data.comment: Above each step of the move. {0} is the step, {1} how many there are.

data.name: DayHeading
data.comment: Heading of step 1.

data.name: DayHint
data.value: Every plant and propagation gets a line in its history on this day. It can be earlier, not later.
data.comment: Under the heading of step 1.

data.name: DayLabel
data.comment: Label of the date field in step 1.

data.name: DayFuture
data.value: The day of the move cannot be later than today.
data.comment: Shown when the date picked is in the future.

data.name: Next
data.comment: Button that goes to the next step.

data.name: Back
data.comment: Button that goes to the step before.

data.name: RoomsHeading
data.comment: Heading of step 2.

data.name: RoomsHint
data.value: A room you leave behind is kept as it was, with its history and photos.
data.comment: Under the heading of step 2.

data.name: WhatHappensTo
data.comment: Read out for the choice of what happens to a room. {0} is the room.

data.name: GoesTo
data.comment: Choice for a room: what is in it goes to a new room.

data.name: CameAlong
data.comment: Choice for a room: the room itself moved along, like a plant cabinet.

data.name: PlaceLater
data.comment: Choice for a room: what is in it is placed one by one after the move.

data.name: LeftBehind
data.comment: Choice for a room with nothing in it: it is left behind.

data.name: GoesToHint
data.value: Everything in it moves to a new room.
data.comment: Under the choice Goes to.

data.name: CameAlongHint
data.value: The room moved with you, like a plant cabinet. It stays as it is.
data.comment: Under the choice Came along.

data.name: PlaceLaterHint
data.value: The room is left behind. You place what is in it afterwards, one by one.
data.comment: Under the choice Place later.

data.name: LeftBehindHint
data.value: Nothing is in it, so it is just left behind.
data.comment: Under the choice Left behind.

data.name: NewRoomLabel
data.comment: Label of the name of the room things go to.

data.name: NewRoomPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder in the name of the new room.

data.name: MadeHere
data.value: New rooms you have named here
data.comment: Read out for the names to tap, which are the new rooms named for other rooms in this move.

data.name: NeedsName
data.value: Give every new room a name to go on.
data.comment: Shown when a room that goes somewhere has no name for the new room.

data.name: SummaryHeading
data.comment: Heading of step 3.

data.name: SummaryDay
data.comment: First line of step 3. {0} is the date.

data.name: SummaryGoesTo
data.comment: After a room's name in the summary. {0} is the new room.

data.name: SummaryCameAlong
data.comment: After a room's name in the summary.

data.name: SummaryPlaceLater
data.value: is left behind, to place later
data.comment: After a room's name in the summary.

data.name: SummaryLeftBehind
data.comment: After a room's name in the summary.

data.name: SummaryNotes
data.value: Rooms you leave behind are kept as they were, and are not offered for new plants. Watering reminders learn again from the move.
data.comment: Under the summary of the move.

data.name: Save
data.comment: Button that saves the move.

data.name: Error
data.comment: Shown when saving the order for going round, or using a room again, fails. {0} is the reason.

data.name: SaveError
data.value: The move could not be saved: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the reason.

data.name: DoneHeading
data.comment: Heading after the move was saved.

data.name: DoneText
data.comment: After saving. {0} is the date.

data.name: DoneNewRooms_One
data.comment: After saving, when {0} is 1.

data.name: DoneNewRooms_Other
data.comment: After saving.

data.name: DoneMoved_One
data.value: {0} plant or propagation moved to its new room
data.comment: After saving, when {0} is 1.

data.name: DoneMoved_Other
data.value: {0} plants and propagations moved to their new rooms
data.comment: After saving.

data.name: DoneToPlace_One
data.value: {0} plant or propagation still to place
data.comment: After saving, when {0} is 1.

data.name: DoneToPlace_Other
data.value: {0} plants and propagations still to place
data.comment: After saving.

data.name: DonePlace
data.comment: Button after saving that opens the page for placing what is left.

data.name: DoneBack
data.comment: Link after saving.

data.name: NoRooms
data.comment: Empty state of the move page.

data.name: NoRoomsHint
data.value: Add the rooms you lived in on Rooms and tags first, then come back to say where everything went.
data.comment: Under the empty state of the move page.

data.name: StillToPlace_One
data.value: {0} plant or propagation still to place after the move
data.comment: Card on Today and line on Rooms and tags, when {0} is 1.

data.name: StillToPlace_Other
data.value: {0} plants and propagations still to place after the move
data.comment: Card on Today and line on Rooms and tags.

data.name: StillToPlaceDetail
data.comment: Under the line about what is still to place.

data.name: RowTitle
data.comment: Row on Rooms and tags that opens the move.

data.name: RowDetail
data.value: Say where everything went and keep the old rooms
data.comment: Under the row on Rooms and tags.

data.name: BeforeTheMove
data.comment: Heading on Rooms and tags over the rooms left behind in a move.

data.name: BeforeTheMoveHint
data.value: Rooms you left behind. They are kept with their history and photos.
data.comment: Under the heading Before the move.

data.name: LeftOn
data.comment: Under a room from before the move. {0} is the date.

data.name: FromBeforeTheMove
data.comment: On the page of a room from before a move. {0} is the date.

data.name: UseAgain
data.comment: Button on the page of a room from before a move.

data.name: PlaceTitle
data.comment: Heading of the page that places what is left after a move.

data.name: PlaceHint
data.value: Pick a room for each plant and propagation, or move everything from one old room at once. Nothing moves until you save.
data.comment: Under the heading of the place page.

data.name: PlaceFrom
data.comment: Heading over the group of things in one old room. {0} is the room.

data.name: MoveAll
data.comment: Choice in a list of rooms that moves everything in an old room.

data.name: MoveAllLabel
data.comment: Read out for the list above. {0} is the old room.

data.name: PickRoom
data.comment: First choice in the list of rooms for one plant.

data.name: PlaceOneLabel
data.comment: Read out for the list of rooms for one plant. {0} is the plant.

data.name: KindPropagation
data.comment: Small text after a name, for a propagation.

data.name: PlaceSave
data.comment: Button that moves what was picked, when nothing is picked.

data.name: PlaceSaveCount_One
data.comment: Button that moves what was picked, when {0} is 1.

data.name: PlaceSaveCount_Other
data.comment: Button that moves what was picked.

data.name: PlaceEmpty
data.comment: Empty state of the place page.

data.name: PlaceEmptyHint
data.value: Everything that stood in an old room has a room now.
data.comment: Under the empty state of the place page.

data.name: PlaceNoRooms
data.value: There is no room to move things to.
data.comment: Shown on the place page when there is no room in use.

data.name: PlaceNoRoomsHint
data.value: Add a room on Rooms and tags first.
data.comment: Under the line above.

data.name: TlKindMovedHouse
data.comment: Label on a history line made by a move house.

data.name: OrderRow
data.comment: Row on a room's page that opens the walking order.

data.name: OrderRowUsual
data.comment: Under the row, when the room has no order of its own.

data.name: OrderRowOwn
data.comment: Under the row, when the room has an order of its own.

data.name: OrderTitle
data.comment: Heading of the page for the walking order of a room.

data.name: OrderHint

data.name: OrderMoveUp
data.comment: Read out for the button that moves a row up.

data.name: OrderMoveDown
data.comment: Read out for the button that moves a row down.

data.name: OrderUsual
data.comment: Button that removes the order of your own.

data.name: OrderSaved

data.comment: After going back to the usual order.
